description: This Java source file defines a final class 'DemoBackend' used for in-memory simulation of backend operations in testing environments. It provides mocked responses for cookie handling, bearer token generation, and CRUD-like operations on job titles, primarily serving test scenarios within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DemoBackend
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to simulate backend responses for testing purposes, such as session cookies, tokens, and CRUD operations on job titles.

methods.name: demoCookiesFor
methods.description: Generates a deterministic in-memory session cookie for a given username.

methods.name: demoBearerTokenFor
methods.description: Generates a deterministic bearer token string for a given username.

methods.name: listJobTitles
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of in-memory job titles, including total, limit, and offset metadata.

methods.name: createJobTitle
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory job title record with provided payload data.

methods.name: deleteJobTitles
methods.description: Deletes job titles by IDs and returns the list of deleted IDs, or an error if input is invalid.
